verdict.rationale: Better Auth is a code-first library: config lives in version control with no dashboard clicks, server-side `auth.api` methods allow programmatic calls, and an official CLI (`npx auth init`, table generation/migrations) is confirmed by community users, so it can plausibly be scripted in pipelines. However, nothing documents CI or headless automation directly, and one hands-on user reports that running admin scripts and tests was hacky because the design is request-header based and plugins don't run otherwise. Missing for 10: documented CI/headless usage guidance, non-interactive CLI flags for automation, clean server-side scripting without request-header workarounds, and independent corroboration of CI use.
